STOP taking 20g of collagen in one shot 🛑 If you're dumping 2 scoops of Vital Proteins in your coffee every morning, you're wasting half of it. Here's why 👇 Collagen synthesis is SLOW and steady. Your body builds collagen gradually, all day long — it can't take a 20g flood and use it all at once. What it can't use in that moment just gets burned as expensive fuel. The smarter way: **7-10g, 3 times a day.** Why it works better: • **Steady supply** — smaller doses keep collagen peptides (glycine, proline, hydroxyproline) circulating all day, so your skin, joints, and gut lining always have building blocks available • **Better absorption** — a moderate dose gets taken up more completely instead of overwhelming digestion in one hit • **Less bloat** — one giant scoop is why collagen makes some people feel heavy and gassy • **Matches how your body builds** — you wouldn't eat all your protein in one meal, and collagen is no different Morning coffee: 1 scoop. Afternoon smoothie or tea: 1 scoop. Evening: 1 scoop. Same total collagen — WAY better results. Your body doesn't need a flood. It needs a drip. 💧 #collagen #vitalproteins #collagenpeptides #skinhealth #jointhealth
